_doc: The prison game's guns and raid companions (prison_arms.gd, prison_squad.gd). Read at start-up and MERGED over the shared game data (`weapons`, `guns`, `weaponArt`) of this process only: the One House game never loads it. `guns` entries are laid over the weapon of the same name in assets/data/map.json (or make a new one when map.json has none: then `gun_art` gives its picture and the table of its hands). A gun's own keys that the rules read: name, range (tiles), cooldown (s between shots), stagger (s a hit stuns the dead, default 0.25) and stagger_chance (the share of hits that stun, default 1), shell_reload (true: the reload loads one shell at a time, reload/mag s each, fire cancels it), mag (rounds), reload (s), dmg (a pellet or a bullet), pellets, spread (radians across, grows while the trigger is held and while walking), sound (a sound of map.json), pitch and vol (the sound), cost (store units of ammo a round costs: ONE ammo stock for every gun, the gun says how many rounds a unit loads: 1 / cost), noise (tiles: the dead within it hear a shot and come, scripts/town/dormant_dead.gd). `blurb` is for the loadout panel only. `armory_start` is what the quartermaster owns at the start. `squad`: the raid companions.

shotgun.blurb: Five pellets, hits hard close up, 6 shells, slow pump. Loud.

service.name: Service rifle
service.blurb: Semi-auto, 8 rounds, one shot at a time, reaches far. 4 rounds to a unit of ammo.

smg.name: SMG
smg.blurb: 30 rounds, very fast, weak and wild. Eats ammo: 16 rounds to a unit.

knife._doc: THE KNIFE (F), always carried, laid over assets/data/melee.json for the prison only (prison_arms.gd apply_knife). Same keys as melee.json: hit_at_s 0.16 plus recover_s 0.34 makes a 0.5 s swing; damage_walker_frac 0.45 of a 5.5 hp walker is 2.5 a stab (a walker of 4 hp dies in 2, of 5 to 7 in 3, a runner in 1 or 2, a screamer of 3 hp in 2); brute_chip_frac 0.07 chips a brute or breacher (1.8 a stab); kind_mult scales a stab on a kind (a bloater is 0.6); noise_hit and noise_kill are tiles, far below a shot (13 to 16).

role_words.gardener: the garden is left to the others
